WITH erps AS (
    SELECT 
        (t1."Display Safety Duration" - t2.displaydurmonths) * (t1."Light Exposure Risk" + 1) * (t1."Conservation Priority Index" + 1) / 100 AS erps,
        t2.artrefused,
        t2.displaydurmonths,
        t1."Display Safety Duration"
    FROM 
        museum_external_knowledge AS t1
    JOIN 
        usagerecords AS t2 ON t1."Display Safety Duration" IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
    t3.artregistry AS "Artifact ID",
    t3.artname AS "Artifact Name",
    t3.mattype AS "Material Type",
    erps.displaydurmonths AS "Current Display Duration",
    erps."Display Safety Duration" AS "Display Limit",
    erps.erps AS "Calculated Score",
    CASE 
        WHEN erps.erps < 50 THEN 'Immediate Rotation'
        ELSE 'Monitor'
    END AS Recommendation
FROM 
    erps
JOIN 
    artifactscore AS t3 ON erps.artrefused = t3.artregistry
WHERE 
    t3.conservestatus = 'Active';
